findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice short questions for Chapter 12 in the same format as the Physics chapter practice, long questions in the Chemistry Board shape (4 marks each) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 72 questions numbered 1-72; by section: u-nitrogen 2, 12.1 3, 12.2 1, 12.2.1 2, 12.2.2 2, 12.2.3 5, 12.3 6, 12.4 1, 12.5.1 4, 12.5.2 2, 12.6 3, 12.7 4, 12.8 1, 12.8.1 1, 12.8.2 2, 12.9 4, 12.10 5, 12.11.2 1, 12.11.3 2, 12.12 1, 12.12.1 1, 12.12.2 1, 12.12.3 1, 12.13 1, 12.13.1 5, 12.13.2 2, 12.13.3 6, 12.13.4 3.

Covers every section in order (nitrogen, N₂ reactivity, ammonia, oxides of nitrogen, NOₓ sources, smog and PAN, catalytic converter, nitrification/denitrification, sulfur, Frost diagram, reactions and uses of sulfur, organic sulfur compounds, sulphuric acid); comparison questions are answered as two-column tables; small numericals use changed amounts and were recomputed in Python; none repeats the chapter exercise. Book corrections followed (balanced NH₄NO₂, NH₄Cl + Ca(OH)₂, FeS₂, V₂O₅ → V₂O₄ and Zn + 2H₂SO₄ equations; NH₄NO₃; NO with 11 valence electrons; Pt/Rh; gypsum CaSO₄·2H₂O; sulfonamides vs beta-lactams).
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
